title: Imports raise ImportError in server scripts (test fixture)
content: Server scripts run in RestrictedPython. Any import statement raises ImportError; frappe, json and datetime are available as globals.

title: Appending a child row (test fixture)
content: doc.append('items', {...}) adds a row to a child table before the parent is saved.

title: frappe.rename_doc is blocked in the sandbox (test fixture)
content: frappe.rename_doc is not callable from a server script; rename through the Desk or a whitelisted method.

title: A note added by a later release (test fixture)
content: Present only in the second version of the test seed file.
